description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-model-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProjectInstruction" name="Project instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Change request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL file"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterCommand" name="Printer command"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_User" name="You" processRef="Process_User"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProjectInstruction" name="Project instruction" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Start_ArtistRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeRequest" name="Change request" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Start_ArtistChanges"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL file" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterCommand" name="Printer command" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Participant_Printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Task_ReceivePrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_User" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create a project" messageRef="Message_ProjectInstruction"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL from artist" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewModel" name="Review 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Color at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckQuantity" name="Check quantity of color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorPathsMerge" name="Continue with plastic"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printing"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder" messageRef="Message_PrinterCommand"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePrinterStatus" name="Receive printer status" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printing preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Printing" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U1" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U2" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U3" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ReviewModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U5" sourceRef="Task_ReviewModel" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U6" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U7" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">notSatisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U8" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U9" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U10" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_CheckQuantity">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAtHome</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U11" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_OrderColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">notColorAtHome</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U12" sourceRef="Task_CheckQuantity" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U13" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">quantityInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U14" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorPathsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">quantityInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U15" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U16" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U17" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorPathsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U18" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U19" sourceRef="Task_PreparationPlaceholder" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U20" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Task_ReceivePrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U21" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePrinterStatus" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U22" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U23" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_U24" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_Printing"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArtistRequest" name="Project instruction received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ProjectInstruction"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateModel" name="Create 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialSTL" name="Send STL to user" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InitialSTL" name="STL sent"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArtistChanges" name="Change request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ModifyModel" name="Change 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSTL" name="Send revised STL to user" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RevisedSTL" name="Revised STL sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_ArtistRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_CreateModel" targetRef="Task_SendInitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="End_InitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Start_ArtistChanges" targetRef="Task_ModifyModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_ModifyModel" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="End_RevisedSTL"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
